title: Data Feedback Loops: Model-driven Amplification of Dataset Biases

bias_targets.methodology: Tracking the amplification of female or male prediction fractions for specific image categories (verbs) with existing gender skews in a visual semantic role-labeling task (imSitu dataset) over successive rounds of data feedback.
Measuring the fraction of predictions for a majority class (e.g., dogs) in an artificially imbalanced image classification task over multiple rounds of model retraining on its own predictions.

Calculating the fraction of conditional language model completions classified as toxic by a pre-trained toxicity classifier (Detoxify) using prompts from the Real Toxicity Prompts dataset over iterative training rounds.
Tracking the average number of quotation marks in generated text as a proxy for structural and repetitive text generation over multiple rounds of data feedback.
